limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments based on the attached screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and supplied runtime account; I did not independently rerun the browser checks or watch a recording.

Corresponding normal, 200%, transition and repeated fixture captures are grouped by screen and key state; the six dimensions are ordered as hierarchy, typography/spacing, surface coherence, task clarity, feedback/recovery and accessibility.

A is the mean of the first three applicable dimensions, F is the mean of the last three applicable dimensions, and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F; the authorized every-item A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met.

No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence: content outside a screenshot is not proof of unreachable content, and supplied browser checks report scrolling, draft retention and reachable actions.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, native notifications and native performance remain deferred and unverified, without blanket browser-score deductions.
Reported axe, contrast and keyboard checks provide useful browser evidence but do not establish every screen’s complete assistive-technology experience.
The filmstrips establish sampled visual continuity only; browser timing claims come from the supplied isolated measurements, not screenshot intervals.
Connected Circles behavior and successful voice capture are not demonstrated; the visible offline and unavailable recovery states are assessed on their own merits.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated, and synthetic prediction/source wording is treated as fixture content rather than a production-copy defect.
The supplied live reading drive supports reported browser task completion but does not establish predictive accuracy or model quality.
Independent painted-layer construction cannot be certified from the images; the supplied account explicitly says room content does not separately translate during the camera move.
topFixes: Synchronize room backgrounds, hero placement and destination controls so the push/pull, shelf and hearth transitions settle as one coherent scene.
Shorten and regroup centered enlarged copy, especially disclosures, explanations, birth profiles and check-ins, to keep the next action easier to discover.
Refine wood edges, contact shadows and parchment mounting; the orb feels seated, but several controls and information panels still look pasted over the room.
Make scroll continuation clearer at input edges and above fixed navigation or Done regions, especially in enlarged invitation and Home views.
Strengthen hierarchy among secondary actions and unify selection markers across focus, person, plan and answer controls.
Improve the Sky window integration and export-preview readability while preserving scalable text alternatives and the demonstrated recovery states.
